title: Full-Stack Web Application Development
shortDescription: Build scalable, secure, and production-ready web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and modern full-stack technologies.
content:
I build scalable full-stack web applications designed around real business requirements. From frontend interfaces and backend APIs to databases, authentication, and deployment, I can handle the complete development lifecycle.

What I Build

  • Business and enterprise web applications
  • SaaS platforms and dashboards
  • E-commerce applications
  • Admin panels and management systems
  • Customer portals and workflow applications

Technology Stack

Depending on the project, I work with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and modern deployment technologies.

The focus is not only on building a working application, but on creating a maintainable, secure, responsive, and production-ready system that can grow with your business.

title: Business & Management Software Development
shortDescription: Custom business management software, ERP systems, SaaS platforms, and workflow applications built around your unique business processes.
content:
Every business has its own workflows, challenges, and operational requirements. I build custom business management software that fits those processes instead of forcing your business into a generic system.

What I Build

  • ERP and business management systems
  • SaaS applications
  • Inventory and sales management systems
  • Employee and workflow management platforms
  • Multi-branch business applications

How I Approach It

The development process starts with understanding your requirements and business workflow. I then design the application architecture, database structure, user experience, APIs, and core functionality before moving into development.

The result is a scalable and maintainable business application designed to support real operational needs and future growth.
tagline: Software designed around the way your business works.

title: Accounting & Financial Software Development
shortDescription: Develop reliable accounting and financial management software with ledgers, transactions, reporting, multi-branch support, and business workflows.
content:
I develop accounting and financial management software for businesses that need structured, accurate, and auditable financial data.

What I Can Build

  • Accounting management systems
  • General ledger and sub-ledger systems
  • Income and expense management
  • Voucher and transaction management
  • Financial reporting dashboards
  • Multi-branch accounting systems

Built for Accuracy

Financial software requires more than a good interface. Database design, transaction integrity, account relationships, reporting logic, and auditability are important parts of the system.

I focus on building financial applications with a structured architecture that can support accurate transactions, reporting, scalability, and day-to-day accounting workflows.
tagline: Reliable software for accurate financial operations.

title: AI Integration & Automation
shortDescription: Add practical AI capabilities to existing products with intelligent assistants, document processing, RAG, automation, and AI-powered workflows.
content:
I help businesses integrate AI into existing software products and workflows to make applications more intelligent, automated, and useful.

What I Can Build

  • AI assistants and chat interfaces
  • AI-powered search and knowledge systems
  • RAG-based applications
  • Document and data processing workflows
  • AI-powered content and business automation
  • Intelligent workflow and decision-support features

Practical AI, Not Just Prompts

AI integration should solve a real business problem. I focus on connecting AI models with your existing application, data, APIs, and workflows rather than simply adding a chatbot.

The goal is to create useful and maintainable AI features that fit naturally into your product and provide measurable value.
tagline: Turn AI capabilities into useful product experiences.

title: API & Backend Development
shortDescription: Build secure, scalable, and well-structured REST APIs and backend systems using Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and modern architecture.
content:
I build scalable backend systems and REST APIs that provide a reliable foundation for web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, and third-party integrations.

Backend Services

  • REST API development
  • Authentication and authorization
  • Database architecture and integration
  • Third-party API integrations
  • File and media management
  • Caching and performance optimization
  • Background jobs and business workflows

Technology & Architecture

My backend development work commonly uses Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and TypeORM.

I focus on clean architecture, validation, security, maintainability, performance, and clear API design so the backend can support both current requirements and future growth.
tagline: A strong backend foundation for reliable products.

title: Legacy Application Modernization & Maintenance
shortDescription: Modernize existing applications, improve performance, fix technical debt, upgrade dependencies, and keep production systems secure and reliable.
content:
Existing software often becomes difficult to maintain as technologies, dependencies, requirements, and business needs change. I help businesses modernize and maintain existing applications without unnecessarily rebuilding everything from scratch.

What I Can Help With

  • Legacy application modernization
  • Performance optimization
  • Technical debt reduction
  • Dependency and framework upgrades
  • Bug fixing and production support
  • Code refactoring
  • Database and API improvements

Modernize Without Disruption

The goal is to understand the existing system first, identify the highest-impact problems, and improve the application step by step.

This approach can help extend the life of an existing product while improving its performance, maintainability, security, and scalability.
tagline: Improve what you already have. Build for what comes next.
